Script.name: asciimap
Script.script:
--[[ ASCII map — our own Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
Aardwolf draws its own map when you send `map`, wrapped in <MAPSTART> and <MAPEND>. We capture that into one of our panels: dockable, resizable, and it remembers its layout like everything else here.
This replaces the AardwolfMudlet module's version rather than adjusting it. Theirs lives in a bare Geyser.MiniConsole called `minimap` that nothing makes draggable, hard-sized 232x255, repositioned by its own minimapsnap() from the GUI layout routine. Four separate bugs came out of trying to reparent and reposition someone else's widget from outside — owning the capture is less code and far less surprise.
Their chain has a race worth noting: `endCapture` closes it on <MAPEND>, so when that runs before the capture child the marker leaks into the output. Ours gags on the way past rather than depending on chain state.
The module still sends `tags map on` and `map`, which is what makes any of this arrive — we just don't use its display. ]]
aard = aard or {} aard.asciimap = aard.asciimap or {}
local AM = aard.asciimap local U = aard.util
local CFG = U.load("asciimap", { on = true, hidetheirs = true, auto = true })
--- -- panel ---
local panel = aard.panel.new({ name = "map", title = "ASCII Map", width = 260, height = 300, -- NOT a negative x: that measures from the right edge of the whole main -- window, docks included, and puts the panel underneath the Map dock where -- it draws invisibly. Same trap that hid Recall Manager. x = "20px", y = "440px", fontSize = 9, wrap = false, -- the art is column-aligned; wrapping mangles it })
AM.panel = panel
-- An empty console on a black background looks like nothing at all. Put a note -- in it so "is it even there?" has an answer you can see. local function placeholder() if panel.console and (getLineCount(panel.console.name) or 0) < 2 then panel:cecho("<#8a93a8>ASCII Map<r>\n<#8a93a8>send 'map' to draw<r>\n") end end
--- -- capture -- -- Armed only between the markers. A permanent catch-all would run Lua on every -- line the MUD sends, and leaving one armed is how you eat a session. ---
local grab_id, safety_id, capturing = nil, nil, false
local function disarm() capturing = false if grab_id then killTrigger(grab_id); grab_id = nil end if safety_id then killTimer(safety_id); safety_id = nil end end
local function grab() local line = getCurrentLine() if line:find("<MAPEND>", 1, true) then deleteLine() disarm() return end -- copy with colours intact, then hide it from the main window selectString(line, 1) copy() if panel.console then appendBuffer(panel.console.name) end deleteLine() end
function AM.on_start() deleteLine() -- always: the marker is noise even when we don't capture if not CFG.on then return end disarm() if panel.console then panel.console:clear() end capturing = true grab_id = tempRegexTrigger("^.*$", grab) -- a map that never terminates must not leave the catch-all armed safety_id = tempTimer(4, function() if capturing then disarm() U.warn("ASCII map: <MAPEND> never arrived, capture released.") end end) end
-- Belt and braces: the module's own chain can leak <MAPEND> when its endCapture -- closes the chain before the capture child runs. Catch it either way. function AM.on_end() deleteLine() -- always, for the same reason disarm() end
--- -- keep the module's copy out of the way ---
function AM.hidetheirs() if not CFG.hidetheirs then return end if minimap then pcall(function() minimap:hide() end) end end
-- their minimapsnap() re-places (and can re-show) it from the GUI layout pass local wrapped = false
local function wrap() if wrapped or type(minimapsnap) ~= "function" then return end local original = minimapsnap minimapsnap = function(...) pcall(original, ...) AM.hidetheirs() end wrapped = true end
--- -- keep it current -- -- Aardwolf only draws the map when asked, and the module asks once at login. A -- minimap that shows where you were ten rooms ago is worse than none, so ask -- again when the room changes - debounced, because walking fires this per step. ---
local pending = false
function AM.on_room() if not (CFG.on and CFG.auto) then return end if not panel:visible() then return end if pending then return end pending = true tempTimer(0.3, function() pending = false if CFG.on and CFG.auto and panel:visible() then send("map", false) end end) end
function AM.on_connect() tempTimer(2, function() wrap(); AM.hidetheirs() end) tempTimer(6, function() wrap(); AM.hidetheirs() end) end
--- -- commands ---
function AM.cmd(arg) local verb = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" then panel:toggle()
elseif verb == "status" or verb == "help" or verb == "?" then local c = panel.container local function g(o, f) if not o then return "?" end local fn = o["get_" .. f] local ok, v = pcall(function() return fn and fn(o) or o[f] end) return ok and tostring(v) or "?" end local mw, mh = 0, 0 pcall(function() mw, mh = getMainWindowSize() end) U.help("ASCII Map", { { "capturing", CFG.on and "ours" or "off (module's is in charge)" }, { "panel", panel.mode .. (panel:visible() and "" or ", hidden") }, { "container", c and tostring(c.name) or "NIL" }, { "at", string.format("x=%s y=%s %sx%s", g(c, "x"), g(c, "y"), g(c, "width"), g(c, "height")) }, { "main window", mw .. "x" .. mh }, { "lines held", panel.console and tostring(getLineCount(panel.console.name) or 0) or "-" }, { "module's map", CFG.hidetheirs and "hidden" or "left visible" }, { "hooked", wrapped and "yes" or "no" }, { "auto redraw", CFG.auto and "on room change" or "off" }, { "" }, { "asciimap", "show/hide the panel" }, { "asciimap dock", "pop it out into a dockable window" }, { "asciimap embed", "put it back in the main window" }, { "asciimap clear", "empty it" }, { "asciimap auto", "toggle redrawing on room change" }, { "asciimap module", "hand the map back to AardwolfMudlet" }, { "asciimap mine", "take it back" }, { "" }, { "Drag the title bar to move, the edges to resize - it remembers." }, })
elseif verb == "dock" then panel:setmode("dock") elseif verb == "embed" then panel:setmode("embed") elseif verb == "show" then panel:show(); placeholder() elseif verb == "hide" then panel:hide() elseif verb == "clear" then panel:clear()
elseif verb == "auto" then CFG.auto = not CFG.auto U.save("asciimap", CFG) U.ok("ASCII map redraw on room change: " .. (CFG.auto and "on" or "off"))
elseif verb == "module" then CFG.on, CFG.hidetheirs = false, false U.save("asciimap", CFG) disarm() panel:hide() if minimap then pcall(function() minimap:show() end) end if type(minimapsnap) == "function" then pcall(minimapsnap) end U.ok("ASCII map: handed back to the module.")
elseif verb == "mine" then CFG.on, CFG.hidetheirs = true, true U.save("asciimap", CFG) panel:show() AM.hidetheirs() U.ok("ASCII map: ours again. Send 'map' to redraw it.")
else U.warn("Unknown: asciimap " .. verb .. " ('asciimap help' for the list)") end end
--- -- boot ---
U.killhandler(aard_asciimap_handler) aard_asciimap_handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "aard.asciimap.on_connect")
U.killhandler(aard_asciimap_room_handler) aard_asciimap_room_handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.room.info", "aard.asciimap.on_room")
tempTimer(3, function() wrap(); AM.hidetheirs() end)
if not CFG.on then panel:hide() else placeholder() end
aard.register("asciimap", "Aardwolf's ASCII map, in our own panel", AM.cmd)
